title: VIX futures May 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — on a TUESDAY, pulled off its usual Wednesday by the Juneteenth closure 30 days later
source: OCC: PROMOTED from estimate by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-05-18.md, 2026-09-05) — the sanctioned venue for the flip, and the same move vix-expiration-2026-09-16, -2027-03-17 and -2027-04-21 made. THE RULE, not just the listing: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 461,261 bytes) states verbatim that 'The final settlement date for a contract with the "VX" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires', and that 'If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday.' For the May 2027 contract: third Friday of June 2027 = 2027-06-18; Wednesday 30 days prior = 2027-05-19 (not a holiday); the Friday 30 days after that Wednesday = 2027-06-18, which IS a Cboe Options holiday (Juneteenth observed — cboe.com/about/hours/us-options/ HTTP 200 386,016 bytes shows 'Juneteenth Holiday | Regular Trading Hours: None'; nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars HTTP 200 109,180 bytes 2027 column reads 'Friday, June 18 (Juneteenth National Independence Day observed)'). The second clause fires and settlement moves to Tuesday 2027-05-18. Applying that rule cold reproduces 9 of 9 listed VX settlement dates (U6 2026-09-16, V6 2026-10-21, X6 2026-11-18, Z6 2026-12-16, F7 2027-01-20, G7 2027-02-17, H7 2027-03-17, J7 2027-04-21, K7 2027-05-18). TWO LISTING SURFACES, re-fetched the same day: cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement (HTTP 200, 536,888 bytes) renders `VX/K7 - 2027-05-18` with settlements 21.15 (2026-09-04) and 21.325 (2026-09-03); www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv returns `VX,VX/K7,2027-05-18,21.15` for dt=2026-09-04, 21.325 for 09-03 and 21.375 for 09-02. Checked 2026-09-05
notes: PROPOSED by the juneteenth-market-closure-2027-06-18 initial research (2026-09-05) and PROMOTED to confirmed by this event's own initial research the same day, on strictly stronger evidence than the proposal carried: Cboe's contract-specification rule text rather than listings-and-arithmetic alone. That closes the honest limit the Juneteenth ledger recorded verbatim ('No expiration rule text was obtained… still listings-and-tape rather than rulebook'). THE DISPLACEMENT IS TENOR-PRESERVING, which is the fact a later session most needs and would otherwise re-derive wrong: both legs move back one day — the reference SPX series from Friday 2027-06-18 to Thursday 2027-06-17, and the settlement from Wednesday 2027-05-19 to Tuesday 2027-05-18 — so this contract still measures EXACTLY 30 calendar days, identical to all eight undisplaced contracts, and is comparable to them on equal terms. The rule's other branch is not: a Wednesday holiday moves settlement without moving the Friday, and Cboe's own SOQ text says the time to expiration 'would be increased', giving a 31-day contract. THE TRAP: the naive rule 'VIX settles the third Wednesday' gives 2027-05-19 and is wrong by one day. Applying the real rule to all 28 contract months from 2026-09 to 2028-12 finds EXACTLY ONE displacement — this one — so no second displaced VIX expiration exists to file before 2029. Nothing in src/ or scripts/ computes expiration dates (grepped 2026-09-05, zero hits), so no code is wrong today. THE STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE: the 30-day strip runs 2027-05-19 -> 2027-06-17, 21 trading sessions (Memorial Day 2027-05-31 closed), and contains sifma-bond-early-close-2027-05-28, fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, fomc-2027-06-09 (high), boj-decision-2027-06-11 (medium) and its own terminal opex-2027-06-17 — all estimate. This contract expires before all of them while measuring all of them. That is NOT a reason to expect a premium: the initial research ran the controlled test this contract uniquely enables — VX/H7 and VX/K7 have identical 21-session strips with exactly one closure each and differ only on FOMC membership, so the holiday drag cancels — and the FOMC-in-strip premium came out the WRONG SIGN on all three Cboe settlement dates (-0.0353 / -0.0331 / -0.1208 against a theory demanding at least +0.25). REFUTED, harder than the vix-expiration-2027-04-21 lane could manage on its confounded pair. Impact LOW: it supports one execution guard — nothing trades the 2027-05-18 opening auction, where Cboe's spec ends VX trading at 09:00 ET and the SOQ's first prints are artifacts rather than information — and licenses nothing. No house playbook is opex- or vol-settlement-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped 2026-09-05, zero hits). Every event inside the strip remains estimate; estimates widen caution only.
